name: leg raise dragon flag
description: Advanced core move where the body stays straight while you raise and lower the legs from a bench. It strongly trains the abs.
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head.
Lift your hips and legs so your body is straight from shoulders to toes.
Keep your body rigid and lower slowly without sitting.
Raise your legs back up under control.
Stop before your lower back arches.
